headline: Key Dependencies for Screen Class Functionality
what_breaks: src/textual/dom.py — relies on Screen for rendering content
src/textual/app.py — utilizes Screen for application UI
src/textual/widget.py — Screen is a widget subclass
why: The Screen class is central to rendering and managing terminal content, impacting many components. Changes here can disrupt the functionality of multiple dependent modules.
checklist: Review changes to Screen class methods and properties
Check interactions with BackgroundScreen and other renderables
Ensure compatibility with DOMNode and Widget classes
